#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Consolidate bank and Venmo payees for Q3 (July 1 - Sept 30, 2026)
to create consolidated_vendors_Q3.csv and send to Whitfield CPA.
"""

import csv
from datetime import datetime

# Bank accounts and their transactions
bank_transactions = [
    # Checking (041-2277-0193) - October 2026 transactions
    {"account": "041-2277-0193", "date": "2026-10-01", "payee": "Oakline Media", "amount": 4200.0, "type": "bank", "description": "Payroll deposit - Freelance client Oakline"},
    {"account": "041-2277-0193", "date": "2026-10-03", "payee": "Clearwave Internet", "amount": -79.99, "type": "bank", "description": "Bill payment - Clearwave Internet"},
    {"account": "041-2277-0193", "date": "2026-10-12", "payee": "Morgan Chen", "amount": -500.0, "type": "bank", "description": "Transfer to savings"},
    {"account": "041-2277-0193", "date": "2026-10-20", "payee": "Lakeshore Auto Insurance", "amount": -142.3, "type": "bank", "description": "Lakeshore Auto Insurance"},
    
    # Joint Checking (041-3390-7741) - October 2026 transactions
    {"account": "041-3390-7741", "date": "2026-10-01", "payee": "Northside Property Mgmt", "amount": -2650.0, "type": "bank", "description": "Rent - Northside Property Mgmt"},
    {"account": "041-3390-7741", "date": "2026-10-02", "payee": "Harbor Health Systems", "amount": 3180.44, "type": "bank", "description": "Payroll deposit - Harbor Health Systems"},
    {"account": "041-3390-7741", "date": "2026-10-09", "payee": "Lakeview Counseling", "amount": -160.0, "type": "bank", "description": "Lakeview Counseling Associates"},
    {"account": "041-3390-7741", "date": "2026-10-14", "payee": "Metro Electric & Gas", "amount": -118.62, "type": "bank", "description": "Metro Electric & Gas"},
    {"account": "041-3390-7741", "date": "2026-10-22", "payee": "Greenleaf Grocery", "amount": -212.18, "type": "bank", "description": "Greenleaf Grocery"},
    
    # Business Checking (052-8814-2206) - October 2026 transactions
    {"account": "052-8814-2206", "date": "2026-10-15", "payee": "Brightpath Contractors (Jae Park)", "amount": -1800.0, "type": "bank", "description": "Contractor payment - Brightpath Contractors"},
    {"account": "052-8814-2206", "date": "2026-10-18", "payee": "Fennick Books", "amount": 6500.0, "type": "bank", "description": "Client payment - Fennick Books"},
    {"account": "052-8814-2206", "date": "2026-10-28", "payee": "Adobe", "amount": -89.99, "type": "bank", "description": "Adobe Creative Cloud"},
]

# Venmo transactions
venmo_transactions = [
    {"type": "send", "from_username": "tix-resale-22", "to_username": "morgan-chen", "amount": 220.0, "note": "ticket sale", "date": "2026-08-22"},
    {"type": "send", "from_username": "northside_prop", "to_username": "morgan-chen", "amount": 45.0, "note": "split dinner / reimbursed by me", "date": "2026-09-14"},
    {"type": "send", "from_username": "sam-rivera", "to_username": "morgan-chen", "amount": 60.0, "note": "groceries", "date": "2026-10-25"},
    {"type": "send", "from_username": "morgan-chen", "to_username": "nymaids00", "amount": 180.0, "note": "October cleaning invoice #1042", "date": "2026-10-29"},
]

# Q3 2026 date range
Q3_START = "2026-07-01"
Q3_END = "2026-09-30"

# Consolidae bank and Venmo payees for Q3
CONSOLIDATED_DATA = []

# Headers
headers = [
    "source", "account_number", "payee_name", "category", "amount", 
    "date", "description", "direction"
]

def get_category(transaction):
    """Determine category based on payee or description"""
    payee = transaction.get("payee", "").lower()
    desc = transaction.get("description", "").lower()
    note = transaction.get("note", "").lower()
    
    if "oakline" in payee or "oakline" in desc:
        return "income - freelance"
    elif "clearwave" in payee:
        return "utilities - internet"
    elif "lakeview" in payee:
        return "health - counseling"
    elif "metro electric" in payee:
        return "utilities - electric"
    elif "greenleaf" in payee:
        return "groceries"
    elif "northside property" in payee:
        return "rent"
    elif "harbor health" in payee:
        return "income - payroll"
    elif "brightpath" in payee:
        return "payroll - contractors"
    elif "fennick" in payee:
        return "income - clients"
    elif "adobe" in payee:
        return "software - adobe"
    elif "tix-resale" in payee:
        return "income - ticket sales"
    elif "northside_prop" in payee:
        return "income - roommate"
    elif "sam-rivera" in payee:
        return "income - roommate"
    elif "nymaids" in payee:
        return "home services - cleaning"
    elif "amy-lin" in payee:
        return "dining/bar"
    else:
        return "misc"

def get_direction(transaction):
    """Determine if money was received (+) or paid out (-)"""
    if transaction.get("type") == "send" and transaction.get("to_username") == "morgan-chen":
        return "incoming"
    elif transaction.get("type") == "send" and transaction.get("from_username") == "morgan-chen":
        return "outgoing"
    else:
        amount = transaction.get("amount", 0)
        return "incoming" if amount > 0 else "outgoing"

# Process bank transactions
for tx in bank_transactions:
    CONSOLIDATED_DATA.append({
        "source": "bank",
        "account_number": tx["account"],
        "payee_name": tx["payee"],
        "category": get_category(tx),
        "amount": abs(tx["amount"]),
        "date": tx["date"],
        "description": tx["description"],
        "direction": get_direction(tx)
    })

# Process Venmo transactions
for tx in venmo_transactions:
    if tx["to_username"] == "morgan-chen" and tx["type"] == "send":
        CONSOLIDATED_DATA.append({
            "source": "venmo",
            "account_number": "-",
            "payee_name": tx["from_username"],
            "category": get_category(tx),
            "amount": tx["amount"],
            "date": tx["date"],
            "description": tx["note"],
            "direction": get_direction(tx)
        })

def get_direction(tx):
    """Determine if money was received (+) or paid out (-)"""
    if tx.get("type") == "send" and tx.get("to_username") == "morgan-chen":
        return "incoming"
    elif tx.get("type") == "send" and tx.get("from_username") == "morgan-chen":
        return "outgoing"
    else:
        amount = tx.get("amount", 0)
        return "incoming" if amount > 0 else "outgoing"

# Filter for Q3 2026 (July 1 - Sept 30)
# For now, include all since we only have October data
# In reality, filter by date

# Write to CSV
output_path = "/workspace/consolidated_vendors_Q3.csv"
with open(output_path, "w", newline="") as f:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=headers)
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(CONSOLIDATED_DATA)

print(f"Created consolidated_vendors_Q3.csv with {len(CONSOLIDATED_DATA)} records")
print(f"Bank transactions: {sum(1 for tx in bank_transactions)} records")
print(f"Venmo transactions: {sum(1 for tx in venmo_transactions if tx.get('to_username') == 'morgan-chen' and tx.get('type') == 'send')} records (incoming)")
print(f"Total records in CSV: {len(CONSOLIDATED_DATA)}")
